conventions.base: Same format as cases_witness_v1.json and cases_witness_v11.json, over bundle seed-witness-v1.1, read with witness-v1.md revision 2.
conventions.grammar_spec: A restriction as in revision 2 item 15: optional entries, rules, roots, max_tokens, clones.
conventions.max_edges: Absent = no budget passed. JSON null is passed as an explicit null budget.
conventions.grammar_rejected: expected = {"grammar_rejected": true} means the restriction itself is invalid and must be refused when the bundle is built; no sentence is parsed. Revision 2 gives no error name for this, so none is compared.
conventions.edge_count: Edges of the complete chart as in revision 2 item 1. Present whenever lexical and length checks pass, including on overflow and rootless inputs.
conventions.depends_on: Where a case rests on something revision 2 does not state outright.
